description: This file defines the PlotArea class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling chart plot areas, including properties and methods for styling and managing plot series within a worksheet.

classes.name: PlotArea
classes.description: Represents the plot area of a chart, managing its visual style, layout, and series data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new PlotArea object with optional layout and series data.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of the plot area.

methods.name: getPlotGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the number of plot groups.

methods.name: getPlotSeriesCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of plot series.

methods.name: getPlotGroup
methods.description: Returns the array of DataSeries objects representing plot series.

methods.name: getPlotGroupByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific plot series by index.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the plot series with data from the given worksheet.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the plot area has no fill (show gridlines through chart).

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Returns whether the plot area has no fill.

methods.name: setGradientFillProperties
methods.description: Sets gradient fill stops and angle properties.

methods.name: getGradientFillStops
methods.description: Returns the gradient fill stops array.

methods.name: getGapWidth
methods.description: Returns the gap width between bars in a bar chart.

methods.name: setGapWidth
methods.description: Sets the gap width between bars.

methods.name: getUseUpBars
methods.description: Returns whether up bars are used.

methods.name: setUseUpBars
methods.description: Sets whether to use up bars in the chart.

methods.name: getUseDownBars
methods.description: Returns whether down bars are used.

methods.name: setUseDownBars
methods.description: Sets whether to use down bars in the chart.
